help.a1: Customer ko open karein, Add credit tap karein, amount aur date daalo. Unka pending balance khud update ho jayega. Baad mein paisa lena hai? Payment record karein.
help.a2: Haan — AI Entry par mic tap karein aur apni bhasha mein bolo (jaise "Ramesh ko 2500 diya"). Hum transcribe karenge, details fill karenge, aur aap confirm karke save kare.
help.a3: Haan. Aap income, expenses aur khata entries offline add kar sakte ho — phone mein save honge aur aap online aane par sync ho jayengi.
help.a4: Reports open karein, date range choose karein, aur PDF (print ya WhatsApp ke liye) ya Excel file (accountant ke liye) export karein. Dono mein summary aur sab transactions ka list hai.
help.a5: Malik ke taur par, Settings → Team & roles mein jaao, unka mobile number add karo aur role choose karo. Wo agle login mein access paa jayenge.
help.a6: Woh choice sirf us khoe hue phone par thi, aur sirf owner hi decide kar sakta tha. Aapke account ka kuch nahi kho gaya: nayi phone par customer ko open karein, details check karein (wo saved copy hai), aur apna change dobara enter karein.
